records.supply_level: Tight (Specialist deficit in SaaS, Patents, Clinical)
records.ai_mt_capability: High on literal prose (DeepL / Claude 3.5 / GPT-4o), Moderate-to-Fragile on UI context, zero-pronoun resolution, and keigo register selection.
linguistic_technical_risks: Missing subject/pronoun hallucination in UI strings
Wrong keigo (sonkeigo vs. kenjougo) politeness register
Kanji/Katakana loanword balance
Line-break/kinsoku shori violations

records.supply_level: Moderate-Tight (Native EN translators reading domain-level Japanese)
records.typical_rate_range_usd: $0.07–$0.16 per Japanese source character (~$0.14–$0.32/equivalent EN word)
records.ai_mt_capability: Moderate-High; LLMs handle topic-comment ellipsis better than older NMT but still hallucinate implied subjects in uncontextualized game dialogue and patent claims.
linguistic_technical_risks: Omitted grammatical subjects in Japanese misattributed to wrong speaker
Patent claim scope distortion
Cultural/honorific flattening in literary & game scripts

records.supply_level: High (but DACH engineering/medical specialists command premium rates)

linguistic_technical_risks: 20–35% text expansion breaking fixed mobile/embedded UI buttons
Compound noun hyphenation (Deppenleerzeichen)
Du vs. Sie formality mismatch
Gender-inclusive styling rules (Genderstern/Binnen-I)

linguistic_technical_risks: Regional lexical clashes (Mexico vs. Argentina voseo vs. US neutral Spanish)
20–25% text expansion
Regulatory health literacy grade-level compliance in US Medicaid/ACA notices
